A little about me

More than support. A partner in making things happen.

I’m a Virtual Assistant with over four years of experience supporting businesses across customer service, real estate, B2B sales, and digital operations.

Over the years, I’ve worked with business owners and professionals to manage administrative tasks, organize CRM systems, coordinate projects, create marketing materials, and improve the overall client experience.

I enjoy bringing structure to moving parts, finding better ways to get things done, and making sure the little details never get overlooked.

I believe great support isn’t just about completing tasks. It’s about understanding the bigger picture, anticipating needs, and making someone’s workday a little easier.
